cc_aeroworks.ponder.desk_network.text_1: The Computer Control Desk is one addressable adapter and hosts the embedded computer.
cc_aeroworks.ponder.desk_network.text_2: Same-facing desks connect left and right, but every desk keeps its own position, modules and attached devices.
cc_aeroworks.ponder.desk_network.text_3: The computer may stand at the left, middle or right end without changing network access.
cc_aeroworks.ponder.desk_network.text_4: Together the adapters form one searchable peripheral graph.
cc_aeroworks.ponder.desk_network.text_5: Sneak and right-click any loaded desk with an empty hand to open the embedded terminal.
cc_aeroworks.ponder.desk_network.text_6: Only one embedded computer may own a network of up to 64 fully loaded desks.
cc_aeroworks.ponder.peripheral_search.te: A peripheral on this face belongs to the middle Desk adapter.
Devices on other desks keep their own desk address and attachment side.
The embedded computer indexes all of them in the global peripherals API.
local modem = peripherals.find("endermodem") returns the direct handle when that type occurs once.
With several matches, find returns a table keyed by desk position and side.
Use peripherals.findAll(type) when a program must always receive a collection.
ControlDesk is special: peripherals.find("ControlDesk") always returns every desk by position.
cc_aeroworks.ponder.desk_diagnostics.tex: Two embedded computers create a conflict and disable global graph access.
Normal placement keeps one computer and ejects an accidental duplicate with its data.
Partially loaded or overlong desk rows are rejected instead of loading chunks silently.
peripherals.getNetwork() reports state, revision, desk count and peripheral count.
After a capability-only change, peripherals.refresh() rebuilds the graph and emits attach or detach events.
cc_aeroworks.ponder.display_crafting.tex: A Normal Monitor becomes the small desk display under a Mechanical Press.
An Advanced Monitor becomes the large desk display in the same process.
Both results are programmable display modules, not standalone monitor blocks.
Radar variants use the corresponding display plus a Create: Radars monitor in a Deployer recipe.
cc_aeroworks.ponder.display_mounting.tex: Two small displays may occupy the left and right sockets together.
A small display also fits the big socket.
The large display fits only the big socket.
Each display remains part of its Desk handle and can be addressed from anywhere in the desk network.
Mount the display in the desk whose position will be used as its address.
local desks = peripherals.find("ControlDesk") selects desks by their x,y,z key.
desk.setDisplayText("big", "123") and setDisplayNumber switch to text mode.
Read getDisplaySize before writing pixels because the configured resolution is not fixed.
Pixel methods switch to raster mode; clearDisplay returns to an empty text display.
cc_aeroworks.ponder.radar_controller.hea: Linking a Radar Display as a native monitor
cc_aeroworks.ponder.radar_controller.tex: Mount a small or large Radar Display in the desk that should become the monitor endpoint.
Use the Create: Radars Data Link on the Network Filterer first; the item stores that network source.
Use the same item on the Radar Display desk. A desk without a Radar Display is not accepted.
Create: Radars performs the range check and places its physical Data Link block on the desk.
The desk is now registered in the group's monitorEndpoints like a native monitor.
cc_aeroworks.ponder.radar_direct.header: Using and removing the native desk endpoint
cc_aeroworks.ponder.radar_direct.text_1: Every five ticks the linked desk resolves its filterer and radar from NetworkData.
cc_aeroworks.ponder.radar_direct.text_2: The Radar Display uses the group's DetectionConfig and selected target, not an unfiltered world scan.
cc_aeroworks.ponder.radar_direct.text_3: Background, sweep, filtered contacts and the selected target render on this endpoint only.
cc_aeroworks.ponder.radar_direct.text_4: Additional Radar Display desks need their own physical Data Link blocks, even in the same desk network.
cc_aeroworks.ponder.radar_direct.text_5: Breaking the physical Data Link lets Create: Radars remove the endpoint and the display shows the disconnected X.
